name: Tagokoro Anne
source:
Daugther of Madoka. She is one year older than Haruki. She is a fun-loving and carefree person who enjoys sex as a form of entertainment. 

If she sees at first glance there is good physical chemistry with someone, she immediately tries to have sex.  In fact, her body count is already in the triple digits and is a slutty bitch in general.

She has no reservations at all about her new younger brother, and although she had planned to tease him for a while, it is about time she had a taste of him in bed as well.

However, compared to her sex-monster of a mother, she is relatively sensible and does not forcibly sleep with someone who refuses to have sex with her.
